question: What alternative endpoint from that line is prescribed for the division, O twice-born?
premises: The line again proceeds from the same reference axis.
Another endpoint is specified between parts of the left foot at the big toe.
The instruction is addressed to the twice-born.
inference: The dividing line may alternatively extend to the space by the left foot’s big toe.
uncertainties: The form amataḥ is unusual and its precise force is uncertain.
plain_english: O twice-born, from that line it may then extend to the space at the big toe of the left foot.
